description: Polish REGON Scraper - GUS Business Registry (no API key). Scrape Poland's REGON (GUS) registry anonymously: look up by NIP/REGON/KRS, discover companies by address + PKD, and get local units (jednostki lokalne) as separate rows. No API key required. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

fetchFullReport.description: Fetch each entity's full REGON report (legal form, ownership, dates, contact, full address). Adds one request per record.
fetchFullReport.title: Fetch full report

fetchPkd.description: Additionally fetch each entity's PKD activity codes (main + secondary).
fetchPkd.title: Fetch PKD codes

identifiers.description: The NIP, REGON, or KRS numbers to look up (one search mode at a time).
identifiers.title: Identifiers (NIP / REGON / KRS)

includeLocalUnits.description: Include each entity's local units (jednostki lokalne) as separate rows (recordType=LOCAL_UNIT, with parentRegon).
includeLocalUnits.title: Include local units (jednostki lokalne)

legalForms.description: Keep only entities whose legal form contains one of these phrases (e.g. "spółka z ograniczoną", "spółka akcyjna").
legalForms.title: Filter - legal form

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum records to emit (0 = unlimited). Bounds cost on large regions.
maxResults.title: Max results

minIntervalMs.description: Politeness delay between requests. The site allows ~3/s; keep >= 350ms to avoid the conditional CAPTCHA.
minIntervalMs.title: Min interval between requests (ms)

pkdCodes.description: Keep only records whose PKD code starts with one of these (e.g. "10", "62.01"). Requires fetchPkd.
pkdCodes.title: Filter - PKD code prefixes

pkdMatch.description: 'main' = only the main (przeważająca) PKD must match; 'any' = any reported PKD may match.
pkdMatch.title: PKD match mode

pkdSections.description: Keep only records with a PKD code in these PKD 2007 sections. C=Manufacturing, G=Trade, H=Transport, etc. Requires fetchPkd.
pkdSections.title: Filter - PKD sections (A-U)

searchMode.description: How to look up companies: by NIP, REGON, or KRS number.
searchMode.title: Search mode

name: regdata_polish_regon
